programmes.evidence: Current official Business Administration PhD page explicitly awards PhD and lists Operations Management among research expertise. Original research project and 150 ECTS thesis culminate in public defence. OM is a research field of this broad award, not a separately named specialization or additional degree.
limitations: Four formal specializations listed separately; Operations Management is not itself one of their exact titles. Exact department-to-OM doctoral route mapping not assumed from research centre alone.
